description: This file implements the AudioDelayStatsReporter class, which collects and reports delay statistics for audio processing in WebRTC, including delay variance calculations and histogram logging.

classes.name: AudioDelayStatsReporter
classes.description: A class that measures, calculates variance, and reports audio delay statistics for WebRTC.

methods.name: CalculateVariance
methods.description: Calculates the variance of a vector of integer delay values.

methods.name: AudioDelayStatsReporter
methods.description: Constructor initializing delay histogram bounds and reserve space for delay data.

methods.name: ReportDelay
methods.description: Records delay measurements, updates histograms, and calculates variance when enough data is collected.
